decisions.reader_note: For Check-Cap in 2023 and 2024, outstanding options and warrants are excluded as anti-dilutive during losses. For profitable 2025, the filing instead says those instruments are out of the money and therefore excluded from diluted EPS. The positive 2025 net result includes debt-extinguishment and conversion income despite an operating loss. The November 2022 one-for-twenty reverse split is already reflected retrospectively; no second adjustment is applied. Full share counts and reported EPS retain their scale-zero tags.

As we have reported losses for all periods presented, all potentially dilutive securities have been excluded
decisions.reader_note: For Tenable in 2023–2025, basic and diluted loss per share use the same weighted-average denominator because potential dilution is anti-dilutive in all presented loss periods. The excluded instruments include RSUs, performance stock units, stock options, unvested restricted shares and ESPP shares. The EPS note’s thousands heading applies to shares: scale-three share counts and scale-zero EPS remain unchanged.
